from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,os,json,shutil,hashlib,tarfile,io
repo=Path('/Users/tdenisenko/code/logex');root=Path('/private/tmp/logex-sql-values-bench');root.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
source=json.loads(Path('/private/tmp/logex-sql-values-source.json').read_text())
assert all(hashlib.sha256((repo/p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==h for p,h in source['files'].items())
gates=[json.loads(l) for l in Path('/private/tmp/logex-sql-values-gates.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
assert len(gates)==7 and all(r['exit']==0 for r in gates)
records=[]
for line in Path('/private/tmp/logex-sql-values-gate-6.log').read_text().splitlines():
 try:r=json.loads(line)
 except json.JSONDecodeError:continue
 if r.get('reason')=='compiler-artifact' and r.get('executable') and r['target']['name']=='audit_harness':records.append(r)
assert len(records)==1 and not records[0]['fresh']
shutil.copy2(records[0]['executable'],root/'candidate')
base=root/'base-source';base.mkdir()
archive=subprocess.check_output(['git','archive',source['base']],cwd=repo)
with tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(archive)) as tar:tar.extractall(base,filter='data')
shutil.copy2(repo/'crates/logex-query/tests/audit_harness.rs',base/'crates/logex-query/tests/audit_harness.rs')
for p in base.rglob('*'):
 if p.is_file() and (p.suffix=='.rs' or p.name=='Cargo.toml'):p.touch()
log=root/'base-build.log'
with log.open('w') as out:r=subprocess.run(['cargo','test','-p','logex-query','--test','audit_harness','--release','--locked','--no-run','--message-format=json'],cwd=base,env=os.environ|{'CARGO_TARGET_DIR':str(repo/'target')},stdout=out,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
assert r.returncode==0,log
records=[]
for line in log.read_text().splitlines():
 try:r=json.loads(line)
 except json.JSONDecodeError:continue
 if r.get('reason')=='compiler-artifact' and r.get('executable') and r['target']['name']=='audit_harness':records.append(r)
assert len(records)==1 and not records[0]['fresh']
shutil.copy2(records[0]['executable'],root/'base')
hashes={label:hashlib.sha256((root/label).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for label in ['base','candidate']}
assert len(set(hashes.values()))==2
(root/'build.json').write_text(json.dumps({'base':source['base'],'candidate_source':source,'binaries':hashes,'fixture':(repo/'crates/logex-query/tests/audit_harness.rs').read_text(),'builder':Path(__file__).read_text()}))
# Restore source freshness for subsequent workspace builds.
for p in source['files']:
 if p.endswith('.rs') or Path(p).name=='Cargo.toml':(repo/p).touch()
print(hashes,flush=True)
